rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when something becomes worse in quality or purity.

example.english: After a few years of use, the phone's battery performance began to degrade.
example.traditional: 呢部手機用咗幾年，電池性能明顯變差。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jung6 zo2 gei2 nin4 din6 ci4 sing3 nang4 ming4 hin2 bin3 caa1

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately lowers another person's—or their own—value, status, or dignity.

example.english: You shouldn't degrade yourself just to please others.
example.traditional: 你唔應該為咗討好人而貶低自己。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 wai6 zo2 tou2 hou2 jan4 ji4 bin2 dai1 zi6 gei2
